title: A Model of the Attention Economy: Data, Platforms, and Discovery
title_zh: 注意力经济模型：数据、平台与发现
authors: Chen, Daniel
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model of the attention economy featuring two interlinked markets: a product market, where consumers have limited awareness of firms, and an attention market, where platforms attract attention by investing in free services (e.g., social media, streaming, podcasts) and sell targeted ads using data on consumer preferences. The model provides a tractable framework in which platform investment, ad-driven discovery, product demand, and ad revenue are jointly determined. The effects of data and interoperability policies can reverse over time, platform quality may be inefficiently high or low, and the rise of data-rich digital advertising can coincide with a declining ad revenue-to-GDP ratio.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个注意力经济的动态模型，该模型包含两个相互关联的市场：产品市场（消费者对企业的认知有限）和注意力市场（平台通过投资免费服务（如社交媒体、流媒体、播客）吸引注意力，并利用消费者偏好数据销售定向广告）。该模型提供了一个易于处理的框架，其中平台投资、广告驱动的发现、产品需求和广告收入是共同决定的。数据与互操作性政策的效果可能随时间逆转，平台质量可能处于低效的高或低水平，而数据丰富的数字广告的兴起可能与广告收入占GDP比重的下降同时发生。

title: Colonialism on the Cheap: The French Empire 1830–1962
title_zh: 廉价殖民主义：法兰西帝国（1830–1962）
authors: Denis Cogneau, Yannick Dupraz, Elise Huillery, Sandrine Mesplé-Somps
abstract: How much did France pay for its colonial empire? Did colonies benefit from large transfers from French taxpayers and private investors, or were they, on the contrary, drained of their capital? This paper uses novel budgetary, private investment, and loan data to compute monetary flows between France and the colonies between 1833 and 1962. Public expenditure spent by France on the empire represented only 1.3 percent of its GDP, of which four-fifths was for the military. Trade balance deficits of French colonies were not counterbalanced by large public or private capital transfers from France to the colonies, but by military expenditure from the metropole. Overall, large sums of money were flowing from the colonies to the metropole, a “drain” representing a couple of percentage points of colonial GDP, making French colonies comparable to British India in the twentieth century.
abstract_zh: 法国为其殖民帝国付出了多少代价？殖民地是否从法国纳税人和私人投资者的大规模转移中获益，还是相反，其资本被抽空？本文利用1833年至1962年间法国与殖民地之间新的预算、私人投资和贷款数据，计算了双方的资金流动。法国在帝国上的公共支出仅占其GDP的1.3%，其中五分之四用于军事。法国殖民地的贸易逆差并未通过法国向殖民地的大规模公共或私人资本转移来弥补，而是由宗主国的军事支出所抵消。总体而言，大量资金从殖民地流向宗主国，这种“抽血”相当于殖民地GDP的几个百分点，使得法国殖民地在20世纪与英属印度具有可比性。

title: Agriculture and Natural Disasters: Evidence From the 2015 Nepal Earthquake
title_zh: 农业与自然灾害：来自2015年尼泊尔地震的证据
authors: Rohan Byanjankar
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: This paper examines the short‐ and long‐run effects of the 2015 Nepal Earthquake on paddy production using a difference‐in‐differences framework and district‐level panel data spanning 2010–2019. We document a 10.95% decline in paddy production and a 6.94% decline in yield in earthquake‐affected districts in the short run, with effects fully dissipating over the long run. Decomposing production losses into intensive and extensive margins reveals that the intensive margin explains the majority of losses. Heterogeneity analysis shows that production losses scale with seismic intensity while yield losses operate as a common behavioural shock uniformly across affected districts. Household survey evidence confirms two reinforcing channels: a contraction in agricultural labour supply during the critical planting season and a reallocation of household resources toward reconstruction of damaged dwellings.
abstract_zh: 本文采用双重差分框架及2010–2019年区级面板数据，考察2015年尼泊尔地震对水稻生产的短期与长期影响。研究发现，地震受灾地区的水稻产量在短期内下降10.95%，单产下降6.94%，但长期来看这些影响完全消散。将产量损失分解为集约边际与广延边际后发现，集约边际解释了大部分损失。异质性分析表明，产量损失随地震烈度递增，而单产损失则表现为受灾地区普遍存在的共同行为冲击。家户调查证据证实了两种相互强化的传导渠道：关键播种季节农业劳动力供给的收缩，以及家户资源向受损房屋重建的重新配置。

title: Engine Run, Quality Enhance: Examining the Effects of Energy Steady Supply on Chinese Export Product Quality
title_zh: 引擎运转，质量提升：能源稳定供应对中国出口产品质量的影响研究
authors: Yao Hu, Shan Shao, Hui Wang, Weifen Lin
abstract: Oil is the lifeblood of industry, serving as the core source of power for the operation of industrial machinery. Ensuring its stable supply is crucial for the smooth production process, which in turn is a key determinant in enhancing the quality of export products for enterprises. This study empirically examines the impact of energy supply on the quality of export products and the mechanism of its effect by using a staggered difference‐in‐differences (DID) method with the implementation of China's West‐to‐East Oil Transportation Project as a quasi‐natural experiment. The empirical results show that a dependable energy supply substantially boosts the quality of goods produced for export by various companies. The mechanism analysis shows that energy supply improves export product quality through enterprise performance improvement effects, industry agglomeration effects and supply chain stabilization effects, and it mainly improves export product quality in energy‐importing regions, technology‐intensive industries, private enterprises, and general trade enterprises. Further analysis reveals that a stable supply of energy helps enhance the sustainability of enterprise exports while helping enterprises realize value chain upgrading, helping China get rid of the curse of locking the bottom of the export value chain. The findings of this study help clarify the intrinsic mechanism between energy supply and export product quality and provide an empirical basis for the cross‐regional energy dispatch strategy to help China's export value chain upgrade.
abstract_zh: 摘要 石油是工业的血液，是工业机械运转的核心动力来源。确保其稳定供应对于生产过程的顺利进行至关重要，而这又是提升企业出口产品质量的关键决定因素。本研究以中国“西油东送”工程实施为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法实证检验了能源供应对出口产品质量的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，可靠的能源供应显著提升了各类企业的出口产品质量。机制分析显示，能源供应通过企业绩效提升效应、产业集聚效应和供应链稳定效应改善了出口产品质量，并且主要提升了能源输入地区、技术密集型行业、民营企业和一般贸易企业的出口产品质量。进一步分析发现，稳定的能源供应有助于增强企业出口的可持续性，同时帮助企业实现价值链升级，助力中国摆脱出口价值链低端锁定的困境。本研究结论有助于厘清能源供应与出口产品质量之间的内在机理，并为跨区域能源调度策略助力中国出口价值链升级提供经验依据。

title: Difference-in-differences with unit-specific trends: Bias in post-treatment estimates and a simple alternative
title_zh: 单位特定趋势下的双重差分法：处理后估计的偏差及一个简单替代方案
authors: Mitch Downey
abstract: Researchers often include unit-specific (e.g., state-specific) trends in difference-in-differences (DiD) specifications. Under standard DiD assumptions, these specifications still yield consistent estimates of dynamic treatment effects (i.e., separate effects for each post-treatment time period) but the pooled post-treatment coefficient is not consistent for the average treatment effect. This single coefficient is a weighted average of the dynamic coefficients, but some weights are often negative. This occurs even without a staggered rollout of treatment. Instead of estimating a pooled coefficient, researchers can estimate the average treatment effect as the mean of the dynamic effects. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 研究者常在双重差分（DiD）设定中纳入单位特定（如州特定）趋势。在标准DiD假设下，这些设定仍能得出动态处理效应（即每个处理后期对应的独立效应）的一致估计，但合并处理后期系数并非平均处理效应的一致估计量。该单一系数是动态系数的加权平均值，但部分权重常为负值——即便在非交错式处理推行情况下亦如此。研究者可通过计算动态效应均值来估计平均处理效应，而非采用合并系数。

title: Managing Monetary Policy Normalization
title_zh: 管理货币政策正常化
authors: Gianluca Benigno, Pierpaolo Benigno
abstract: This paper develops a framework for monetary policy normalization in which liquidity conditions shape aggregate demand through a liquidity channel. The model implies that central bank balance sheet operations can stabilize demand even away from the zero lower bound, making reserves an independent policy instrument alongside interest rates. Optimal balance sheet size therefore depends not only on private reserve demand, but also on fiscal interactions and liquidity management. Following shocks that generate a liquidity trap, optimal policy expands reserves at the lower bound, initiates quantitative tightening before rate liftoff, and normalizes rates and reserves together, clarifying balance sheets’ stabilization role.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个货币政策正常化框架，其中流动性状况通过流动性渠道影响总需求。模型表明，即使在远离零利率下限的情况下，央行资产负债表操作也能稳定需求，使准备金与利率共同成为独立的政策工具。因此，最优资产负债表规模不仅取决于私人准备金需求，还取决于财政互动与流动性管理。在引发流动性陷阱的冲击发生后，最优政策在零利率下限扩大准备金，在加息启动前实施量化紧缩，并同步推进利率与准备金正常化，从而阐明资产负债表的稳定作用。

title: To Catch a Thief: Endogenous Policing and Choice of Location by Criminals
title_zh: 捉贼记：内生性警务与犯罪者的地点选择
authors: Siddhartha Bandyopadhyay, Antonio Cabrales, Kaustav Das
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of offender location choice and police resource allocation across multiple areas. Individuals differ in the cost of apprehension and choose whether to commit crime and, if so, where. Each area contains a fixed value of criminal opportunities, so offenders impose congestion on one another, while policing affects expected apprehension. For arbitrary policing levels, equilibrium sorts offenders by apprehension cost across areas ordered by policing per unit of criminal opportunity value. With a fixed police budget, welfare maximization equalizes policing-to-value ratios across all active areas. The model shows when place-based policing should target the value of criminal opportunities rather than observed crime counts alone, since observed crime may already reflect prior police allocation and offender displacement.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个可处理的模型，用于分析犯罪者跨区域选址行为与警力资源分配问题。个体在逮捕成本上存在差异，需决定是否实施犯罪及选择犯罪地点。每个区域拥有固定价值的犯罪机会，因此犯罪者之间会产生相互拥挤效应，而警务活动则影响预期逮捕概率。在任意警力配置水平下，均衡状态会按照单位犯罪机会价值对应的警力密度，将犯罪者按逮捕成本排序至不同区域。在警力预算固定的条件下，社会福利最大化要求所有活跃区域的警力-价值比趋于均等。该模型表明，基于地点的警务策略应瞄准犯罪机会的价值而非仅关注观测到的犯罪数量——因为后者可能已反映先前的警力配置与犯罪者转移效应。

title: 国际数字服务税的税负转嫁——兼论中国参与国际税改的路径
authors: 吴鹏, 马述忠, 刘锴
official: 官方发布 2026-06-20 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 数字服务税（DST）的出现加剧了国际税收协调的难度，探讨其税负转嫁问题对中国参与国际税改至关重要。本文基于2019—2021年国家—产品—年月层面的中国跨境电商出口数据，通过研究目的国实施DST政策对中国跨境电商出口的影响，探讨DST导致的税负转嫁行为。研究结果表明：DST导致的税负可以转嫁，最终会导致中国跨境电商出口规模的缩减。对税负转嫁路径的分析发现，大型互联网企业通过提高履单费和广告费等方式...

title: Competitive Advertising and Pricing
title_zh: 竞争性广告与定价
authors: Ilwoo Hwang, Kyungmin Kim, Raphael Boleslavsky
abstract: We consider an oligopoly model in which each firm chooses not only its price but also its advertising strategy regarding how much, and what, product information to provide. To highlight firms' strategic incentives, we impose no structural restrictions on feasible advertising content, so that each firm can disclose or conceal any information. We obtain a comprehensive characterization of the equilibrium advertising strategy and provide some sufficient conditions for the existence of symmetric pure-price equilibria. We show that intense competition induces firms to provide accurate product information; firms usually obfuscate consumers' relatively low or high values; and requiring firms to provide more product information can reduce social surplus and also be harmful to consumers.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个寡头垄断模型，其中每个企业不仅选择其价格，还选择其广告策略，即提供多少以及何种产品信息。为突出企业的策略性激励，我们对可行的广告内容不施加任何结构性限制，因此每个企业可以披露或隐瞒任何信息。我们全面刻画了均衡广告策略的特征，并给出了对称纯价格均衡存在的一些充分条件。研究表明，激烈的竞争会促使企业提供准确的产品信息；企业通常会模糊消费者相对较低或较高的价值；而要求企业提供更多产品信息可能会减少社会剩余，并对消费者造成损害。
